description: For current Grade, send version bsd-agent-grade-v1 and action: list (optional limit 1-20 and cursor), job or report (jobId UUID required), or progress (jobId UUID required; optional after 0-1000000 and limit 1-100). Readiness requires a readable saved report. For legacy reports only, omit version/action and send optional report_id and limit 1-25. Never mix current and legacy fields.

report_id.description: Legacy saved report ID; omit version and action.

title: Saved Grade jobs and reports
